name: small
summary: Build and review a small change that touches no UI or data path, with no plan gate.

phases.name: build
phases.instruction: Read every record in the change's surfaced list; adopt a matching open task with `changes.attach --task` instead of working beside it. Write a one-paragraph plan with `board call changes.plan` naming the paths you will edit. Build test-first, record the head and attach a run of {suite} on it.

checks.remedy: This change touches a UI or data path, so it needs the development flow: run `board call changes.reflow --path {change} --flow development`.

phases.name: review
phases.instruction: Review {head} with clean context with `board call review.run`, fix every critical or high finding and review again.

phases.name: land
phases.instruction: Draft and open the pull request with `board call changes.pr --path {change}`, record it with `board call github.ref` and attach it with --pull.
